title: A shared garden
text: Our school had a small empty space behind the dining hall. Last spring, our class decided to turn it into a [[1]]. At first, we thought growing vegetables would be easy. We planted seeds and waited, [[2]] very little happened. Our science teacher asked us to check the soil and the light. We found that one corner was too [[3]]. We moved some pots to a brighter place and made a watering plan. Everyone had a small job, so no one had to do [[4]] alone. A month later, the first leaves appeared. We did not grow much food that term, but we learned to [[5]] each other's work. Now, when a plant grows slowly, we look for a reason [[6]] giving up.
items: garden
car park
classroom
growing vegetables 和 planted seeds 都指向种植植物的花园。
car park 用来停车，不能与下文种菜衔接。
classroom 与露天空地上的种植活动不符。
but
so
because
以为容易，实际几乎没有变化，前后构成转折。
so 表结果，不能表达预期与结果的落差。
because 会把“没有长出来”误作前面等待的原因。
dark
bright
warm
下文移到 brighter place，说明原位置光照不足。
如果已经 bright，就不能解释为什么要移到更亮处。
下文解决的是光照，不是温度。
everything
nothing
someone
每人分担小任务，所以没有人需要独自做全部事情。
do nothing 是什么也不做，与共同分担不符。
do someone 不能在这里表示完成任务。
value
hide
forget
共同劳动带来的收获是珍惜彼此的付出。
hide 表示隐藏，不能解释共同合作的积极收获。
forget 与 learned 的积极结果和全文主题相反。
instead of
because of
together with
遇到生长慢的问题先找原因，而不是放弃；instead of 后接 doing。
because of 表原因，会变成因放弃才找原因。
together with 表伴随，不表达替代放弃的选择。

title: The question box
text: Our English club used to begin with a long talk from the leader. A few students answered questions, but most stayed [[1]]. Then we placed a question box by the door. Everyone could leave a question without writing a [[2]]. At the next meeting, the leader read the notes and asked small groups to choose one to discuss. The questions were not always difficult. One asked how to remember a word after a week. Another asked what to do when a story had too many new words. These were problems many students [[3]]. Because the questions came from the group, more people wanted to [[4]]. We still had a leader, but the leader's job changed. Instead of giving every answer, she helped us find a useful way to [[5]] for one. The little box did not make learning effortless. It made our meetings more [[6]] to the people in the room.
items: quiet
excited
absent
只有少数人回答，but 后说明大多数人保持安静。
excited 没有被前后对比支持，核心问题是发言少。
stayed absent 不符合已在会议中的这群学生。
name
question
sentence
without writing a name 表示匿名，减少提问顾虑；每人仍需留下问题。
前文明说 leave a question，不能又不写问题。
问题往往就是句子，不能作为这条规则的合理对象。
shared
avoided
created
这些问题是许多学生共同面对的，而不仅是某个人的。
avoided 表示避开，与希望讨论如何解决问题不符。
这里说遇到的学习困难，不是故意制造问题。
join in
give up
go away
问题来自大家，所以更多人愿意参与讨论。
give up 与更多人愿意参与的改进结果相反。
go away 表示离开，与愿意讨论的因果关系不符。
look
pay
wait
look for an answer 表示寻找答案，与不直接给答案的做法对应。
pay for an answer 表示付费购买答案，全文没有费用情境。
wait for 表示等待，不能体现一起探索办法的主动性。
useful
expensive
private
内容来自学生真实问题，因此会议对参与者更有用。
expensive 表示昂贵，文中没有收费或成本变化。
匿名问题不等于会议变成私人活动。
